problems.memo_sentence: "The review identifies multiple limitations of existing approaches: traditional portfolio selection methods suffer from estimation error, necessitating regularization; mean–variance models scale poorly due to covariance computation; MAD penalizes both positive and negative deviations; minimax is sensitive to outliers and requires complete historical data; VaR is simplistic and does not incorporate richer risk measures; and CVaR cannot indicate maximum loss."
